event_allocations_role_shape_check.name: event_allocations_role_shape_check
event_allocations_role_shape_check.value:
("event_allocations"."role" = 'PAYER'
          AND "event_allocations"."amount_minor" > 0
          AND "event_allocations"."split_method" IS NULL)
        OR ("event_allocations"."role" = 'PARTICIPANT'
          AND "event_allocations"."amount_minor" > 0
          AND "event_allocations"."split_method" IS NOT NULL)

idempotency_keys_state_shape_check.name: idempotency_keys_state_shape_check
idempotency_keys_state_shape_check.value:
("idempotency_keys"."status" = 'PROCESSING'
          AND "idempotency_keys"."lock_token" IS NOT NULL
          AND "idempotency_keys"."locked_until" IS NOT NULL
          AND "idempotency_keys"."response_status" IS NULL)
        OR ("idempotency_keys"."status" = 'COMPLETED'
          AND "idempotency_keys"."lock_token" IS NULL
          AND "idempotency_keys"."locked_until" IS NULL
          AND "idempotency_keys"."response_status" BETWEEN 100 AND 599)

ledger_members_lifecycle_shape_check.name: ledger_members_lifecycle_shape_check
ledger_members_lifecycle_shape_check.value:
("ledger_members"."status" IN ('INVITED', 'DECLINED', 'CANCELLED')
          AND "ledger_members"."invited_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "ledger_members"."invited_at" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("ledger_members"."status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'LEFT')
          AND "ledger_members"."joined_at" IS NOT NULL)

ledgers_direct_shape_check.name: ledgers_direct_shape_check
ledgers_direct_shape_check.value:
("ledgers"."type" = 'DIRECT'
          AND "ledgers"."direct_low_user_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "ledgers"."direct_high_user_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "ledgers"."direct_low_user_id" < "ledgers"."direct_high_user_id")
        OR ("ledgers"."type" = 'GROUP'
          AND "ledgers"."direct_low_user_id" IS NULL
          AND "ledgers"."direct_high_user_id" IS NULL)

user_identities_password_shape_check.name: user_identities_password_shape_check
user_identities_password_shape_check.value:
("user_identities"."provider" = 'PASSWORD' AND "user_identities"."password_hash" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("user_identities"."provider" <> 'PASSWORD' AND "user_identities"."password_hash" IS NULL)
